insurer: Zurich Kotak General Insurance Company (India) Limited

room_rent.note: If room taken at higher rate, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-payment applies to every admissible claim for all insured persons

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments at 50% SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: lower of 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year; listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, etc.) capped at 50% of SI; ambulance ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: Reducible via portability/migration credit; no optional add-on to reduce further

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, piles, calculi, etc.; 36-month list includes joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free renewal year; maximum 50% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; 24-hour hospitalisation limit not applicable

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded (Section 7.18)

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expense cover in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical consumables (gloves, masks, diapers, etc.) explicitly excluded in Annexure-A List I

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded (Section 7.19 and 10.7)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, claims cannot be contested except for fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/quarterly/half-yearly; 15 days for monthly instalment; no coverage during grace period

free_look.note: Applicable only at inception, not on renewal or porting

portability.note: IRDAI-compliant portability with continuity of waiting period credits

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary & OPD, maternity, infertility/IVF, refractive error <7.5D, treatment outside India, obesity surgery (conditional), gender change
